title: Site config
description: The site config file. Every key is optional; an unknown key is an error.

title.description: Site name for the header, page titles, llms.txt, and JSON-LD. Default: the folder name.

description.description: One-sentence summary of the site, for the home page's meta description and llms.txt.

url.description: Scheme and host of the published site, without a trailing slash, such as https://example.github.io. Without it canonical links, the sitemap, and social images are relative or left out, with a warning.

base.description: Path the site lives under, starting with / and without a trailing slash; empty at a domain root. Every URL the engine writes carries it.

lang.description: Default language of every page, as a BCP 47 tag. A page's lang wins.

dir.description: Default text direction. Unset, it comes from lang (rtl for fa, ar, he, ur, and the other right-to-left languages). A page's dir wins.

languages.description: The site's languages in switcher order. Leave it out for a one-language site.

source.description: Folder that holds the content, relative to the site root. Files outside it are not pages.

include.description: Paths under source that discovery would skip (names starting with . or _) but should be copied or built, such as .well-known.

exclude.description: Paths under source that are neither pages nor copied. node_modules, the output folder, and the config file are always excluded.

navigation.description: Navigation file, relative to the site root. When it does not exist, navigation is built from folders and each page's order.

collections.description: Data collections by name: where their records come from and how their pages are built. Default {}.

feeds.description: Feeds of collections' records by name: which records, how many, and which formats. Default {}.

calendars.description: Calendars of collections' dated records by name, written as .ics files under calendars/. Default {}.

posts.description: Folder that holds the posts, relative to the site root. A post is a Markdown file with `date` and `author` in its front matter; setting this key turns the blog on.

route.description: Public prefix of every blog URL: one URL segment, without a slash. Default blog.

archive.description: Archive route under the prefix: one URL segment, without a slash. Default archive.

authors.description: Write one page per author under the prefix. Default true.

feed.description: Write the blog's Atom feed. Default true.

pageSize.description: Posts per index page, a whole number of at least 1. Default 10.

blog.description: The blog: a folder of dated posts, with an archive, one page per author, and a feed.

source.description: One pinned OpenAPI 3.1 or 3.0 document, YAML or JSON, relative to the site root. A build reads this file and nothing over the network.

path.description: URL path the reference lives under, starting and ending with `/`. Default /reference/.

apiReference.description: A static, searchable reference built from one OpenAPI document.

defaults.description: Front matter applied to every page under a path unless the page sets the key itself. Later entries win over earlier ones; a page always wins.

url.description: The repository's web URL, such as https://github.com/example/example.

branch.description: Branch that edit links point to.

dir.description: The site root's folder inside the repository, such as docs.

repository.description: Where the source lives, for Edit this page links and the Edit with your agent prompt.

name.description: Theme package or folder. Default: the theme that ships with the engine.

options.description: Handed to the theme unread; the theme validates it against its own schema.

layouts.description: Layout name → the site module that replaces it.

components.description: Component name → the site module that replaces it.

overrides.description: Site modules that replace selected theme units. The path is relative to the site root; a missing file, a path outside the root, or a name the theme does not have is an error. A replacement may add a `<file>.css` sidecar beside it; it brings no client island. Every unit not named here stays the theme's.

theme.description: The theme that builds the site and the options handed to it.

text.description: The most characters of a page's body the index keeps. Titles and headings are always indexed.

search.description: false builds no search index. As an object, text sets how much of each page's body the index keeps.

failOnFailure.description: Report a failed example as an error at its fence, so `mizzen check` exits 1. Default false.

examples.description: How the examples-report output treats a failing example. Default: a warning that never fails the build.

source.description: The shared network file: an https URL or a path. Only `mizzen network update` reads it.

project.description: The id of this project in the network file.

maxAgeDays.description: A build warns when network.lock.json is older than this many days. Default 30.

network.description: Joins the site to a shared network of projects. Default: none, and the site builds on its own.

asOf.description: The day the build pretends it is, YYYY-MM-DD; the --as-of flag wins. The build never reads the clock. Default: none.

calendar.description: The calendar dates are written in. Default: gregorian.

maxAgeDays.description: `mizzen doctor` reports a collection whose snapshot was captured more than this many days before today. Default: never.

snapshot.description: How old a collection's recorded snapshot may be. Default: none.

rules.description: Rules that report missing fields and falling coverage or counts. Default []: nothing is reported.

exceptions.description: Dated exceptions: findings the rules would make that are held back until a day. Default [].

completeness.description: How a completeness finding is reported. Default warning.

coverage.description: How a coverage finding is reported. Default warning.

count.description: How a count finding is reported. Default warning.

threshold.description: How a threshold finding is reported. Default warning.

outlier.description: How an outlier finding is reported. Default warning.

freshness.description: How a freshness finding is reported. Default warning.

policy.description: How a finding of each kind is reported. Default warning.

quality.description: Data-quality rules and dated exceptions. Default: none, and `mizzen data quality` reports nothing.

version.description: The version path segment of the API, such as v1. Default v1.

collections.description: The collections published by name. A collection not named here is never published.

headers.description: true writes a _headers file with CORS and cache rules for /api/*, for hosts that read one; a _headers file the site already has is never replaced. Default false.

versions.description: Further versions of the API by name, published beside the current one (version), each with its own collections and field lists.

maxFileBytes.description: Warn when an API file is larger than this many bytes, advising the NDJSON file; a file is never truncated. Default: no limit.

api.description: The versioned static data API written under api/<version>/. Default: none, and nothing is written.

root.description: The folder a page's `covers` paths are relative to, relative to the site root. Default `.`.

severity.description: How `mizzen check` and `mizzen doctor` report a stale page. Default `warning`.
How a contract failure (a signature mismatch, a removed symbol, or a moved symbol) is reported in `drift.json` and by `mizzen doctor`. Default `warning`; an unchecked claim stays a warning.

drift.description: How the API contract findings `drift.json` writes are reported. Default: none, and a contract failure is a warning.

provider.description: The tool. There is no default: a site without the key gets no script.

site.description: GoatCounter code, Plausible domain, Umami website id, or Cloudflare beacon token.

host.description: Origin that serves the script and receives the hits, for a self-hosted tool.

attrs.description: custom only: attributes written on the script tag.

allowedOrigins.description: Outside origins the site may contact; a built page that reaches any other origin earns a warning.

provider.description: A provider that needs a site value.

analytics.description: A cookieless analytics tool, attached as one deferred script tag. Default: none.

template.description: The default template of every page's share image: the file `_templates/social/<template>.svg` in the source folder. A page names another in its front matter `social`, or `false` to have no image.

fonts.description: Font files the images are drawn with, relative to the site root: `.ttf`, `.otf`, or `.woff`. No system font is ever used.

social.description: Generated social share images. Default: none, and no image is written.

google.description: Google Search Console token, written as a meta tag on the home page.

bing.description: Bing Webmaster token, written as a meta tag on the home page.

googleFile.description: Google's HTML verification file name, written at the site root.

bingFile.description: Bing's user id, written as BingSiteAuth.xml at the site root.

verify.description: Search engine verification tokens. A provider not set gets no tag and no file.

redirects.description: Redirect pages: each key is an old path under base, each value a path on the site or an https URL.

outputs.description: Turns an output off by its name (false), such as twins or llms. The loader checks the names against the output registry; an unknown name is an error.

transformStep.description: One transformation step. `op` names the operator; the other keys are the ones that operator reads.

id.description: The rule's id, used by diagnostics and events. Default: step-<position>, counting from 1.

op.description: The operator: keep or remove fields, move a field, fill a default, convert a type, unit, or date, normalize text, map categories, filter records, or deduplicate them.

fields.description: Field paths the `select` and `remove` operators read, as dot paths such as author.name.

field.description: The field path a single-field operator reads.

from.description: The path a `rename` step reads the value from.

to.description: The path a `rename` step writes the value to, or the type a `cast` step converts to.

onConflict.description: What a `rename` does when a value already sits at `to`: report it and leave the record, or replace it. Default error.

value.description: The value a `default` step writes when the field matches `when`.

when.description: Which values a `default` step replaces: an absent field, null, or either; write `"null"` or `null`. Zero is never missing. Default missing.

trim.description: Trim whitespace from both ends of a `normalize` value. Default true.

case.description: The case a `normalize` step writes. Default none.

values.description: The value a recognized input becomes, keyed by the input written as text, for a `map` step.

unknown.description: What a `map` step does with a value its mapping does not name: keep it, report it, or write `default`. Default keep.

default.description: The value a `map` step writes for an unrecognized input when unknown is default.

format.description: The input format of a `date` step: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, and ss, with literal separators, such as DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone a `date` step's input is written in, such as Asia/Tehran or UTC.

output.description: What a `date` step writes: a UTC ISO 8601 instant (iso) or a YYYY-MM-DD day (date). Default iso.

factor.description: The number a `unit` step multiplies the value by.

round.description: Decimal places a `unit` step rounds to. Default: no rounding.

where.description: The conditions a record must match for a `filter` step, keyed by field path; every condition must hold. A list value matches any of its items.

by.description: The field paths that make up a `dedupe` step's key, as dot paths.

keep.description: Which record of a `dedupe` key survives: the first or the last in source order. Default first.

themeModules.description: A unit name and the site module that replaces it, relative to the site root.

kind.description: What the rule measures: a missing field, a field's coverage drop, a record-count drop, a value outside a threshold or range, or a date older than a limit.

fields.description: The fields it checks. Default: every field the collection's records hold.

field.description: For `freshness`: the date field whose age the rule measures. Required for that kind.

where.description: A record must match to be in scope, written like a list page's `where`. Default: every record.

severity.description: How this rule's findings are reported. Default: the `quality.policy` entry for its kind, then `warning`.

maxDrop.description: For `coverage` and `count`: how much the value may drop before the rule reports. Required for those kinds.

maxAgeDays.description: For `freshness`: how many days before the as-of date a record's date may be. Required for that kind.

min.description: For `threshold` and `outlier`: the lowest value the field may hold. At least one of `min` and `max` is required.

max.description: For `threshold` and `outlier`: the highest value the field may hold. At least one of `min` and `max` is required.

qualityRule.description: One data-quality rule: what it measures, on which collection, and when it reports.

rule.description: The kind of finding it covers.

record.description: The record it covers. Default: every record.

field.description: The field it covers. Default: every field.

until.description: The last day it holds, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default: no end.

qualityException.description: A dated exception: a finding the rules would make, held back until a day.

fields.description: The record fields the API publishes. A field not listed is never written.

id.description: The key the record id is published under in every file. Default id.

apiCollection.description: One collection of the data API.

name.description: Name shown in the language switcher, in that language.

prefix.description: URL prefix of this language's pages, such as /fa; empty for the default language.

path.description: Folder relative to source; empty for every page.

values.description: Front matter keys and values to apply.

source.description: Data file the records are read from, relative to the site root.

records.description: Dot path to the record array inside a JSON API response, such as data.items. Setting it marks the source as a JSON API; mizzen data fetch stores the records as one list and a build reads that list.

pagination.description: How mizzen data fetch walks a paginated API. Unset: one request.

id.description: Field that holds a record's id; the mapping key when absent.

template.description: Markdown template under _templates/, relative to the source folder.

permalink.description: URL pattern of a record page, such as /items/{id}/.

disambiguate.description: Field appended to a record URL when another record's pattern gives the same one, such as id.

aliases.description: Field that holds earlier ids or paths of a record, each of which redirects to the record's page.

schema.description: JSON Schema file that validates every record, relative to the site root.

schemaRenames.description: Fields an earlier record may still hold under an old name, keyed by the new name: `{ slug: path }` reads `path` as `slug`. A record that holds both keeps the new one and earns a warning naming its line. Default {}.

onSchemaChange.description: What a schema change that earlier records may not satisfy does: error fails the build; warn reports a warning. Default error.

unique.description: Fields whose values must be unique in the collection; a duplicate is an error naming both records.

references.description: Fields that hold a reference to another collection's record id, keyed by field name.

dates.description: Fields that hold a date, written YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY, or as a full ISO 8601 instant.

referenceDate.description: The date a list compares before or after against: YYYY-MM-DD, or the dot path of a _data value that holds one. Unset, a list cannot filter on a relative date.

derived.description: Values computed once per build from a record's date field against the as-of date, keyed by the name a template or the theme reads. A real field with the same name wins. Default {}.

markdown.description: Fields that hold Markdown, rendered through the page pipeline with their positions in the data file.

llms.description: false keeps the collection's record pages out of llms-full.txt.

fields.description: Fields the page JSON publishes, in this order; empty publishes none.

json.description: Which record fields the page JSON publishes. Unset publishes every field.

evidence.description: Top-level record field that maps the record's other fields to the claims that back them, each with an id, title, and url; absent keeps evidence off.

onInvalid.description: What an invalid record does: error fails the build; skip leaves it out of the site with a warning.

redirect.description: A page on the site the removed record's URLs redirect to.

onRemoved.description: What a record that was published and is no longer in the collection does: error fails the build, gone writes a removed notice, or redirect sends readers to a page. Default error once urls.lock.json exists.

field.description: Field that holds a record's state. Default `state`.

states.description: States a record may have; a value outside the list is reported. Default []: every state is accepted.

retired.description: States that mean a record is retired. Default []: no state retires a record.

replacement.description: Field that holds the id of the record that replaces a retired one.

url.description: What a retired record's URL does: retain keeps its page, redirect sends readers to the replacement. Default retain.

machine.description: true marks a retired record for machine readers, such as the page JSON. Default false.

lifecycle.description: A record's state in the collection's lifecycle, and what a retired record's URL does. Unset: every record is published.

views.description: Extra named pages built from every record, each with its own template, URL pattern, and layout. Default {}.

meta.description: Fields written as result metadata under the field's own name. Default [].

filters.description: Fields a reader can filter by; a list field gives one filter value per item. Default [].

sort.description: Fields results can be ordered by: dates, numbers, or short text. Default [].

aliases.description: Field that holds other names of a record, indexed so a search for one finds the page.

search.description: How the collection's record pages take part in search.

titleMax.description: Longest title a record page may have before a warning. Default 70.

descriptionMax.description: Longest description a record page may have before a warning. Default 160.

canonical.description: Field that holds a record's own canonical URL; front matter canonical_url still wins.

noindex.description: Field that marks a record as not to be indexed: a true value writes noindex and leaves the page out of the sitemap.

lastmod.description: Field that holds the date of a record's last change, written as the sitemap's lastmod.

jsonLd.description: Structured data of each record page: a mapping with an @type, whose string values may name fields as {field}.

breadcrumbs.description: false leaves the BreadcrumbList off record and list pages. Default true.

itemList.description: false leaves the ItemList off list pages. Default true.

seo.description: How the collection's record and list pages are described to search engines.

changelog.description: The collection's change history, written by `mizzen data changes` to `data-changes/<name>.jsonl`. Default: none.

track.description: Fields whose changes are recorded. No field is tracked unless it is named. Default [].

ignore.description: Fields never recorded, even when `track` names them. Default [].

labels.description: A summary template per event type. `{id}`, `{field}`, `{old}`, `{new}`, `{from}`, `{count}`, and `{<record field>}` are replaced.

added.description: The summary template of a `added` event.

removed.description: The summary template of a `removed` event.

changed.description: The summary template of a `changed` event.

renamed.description: The summary template of a `renamed` event.

imported.description: The summary template of a `imported` event.

importThreshold.description: A run that finds more events than this is written as one `imported` event. A first load is always one. Default: no limit.

pages.description: Build one list page per snapshot date and a newest-events page, and write the Atom feed. Default false.

transform.description: Rules that rewrite each record before it is validated and published, applied in order. Without it a collection publishes its records exactly as the source writes them.

steps.description: The transformation steps, applied in this order; each step reads the record the previous step wrote.

validate.description: When records are checked against the collection's schema: `after` validates the transformed record, `before-and-after` also reports a raw record that does not match and still transforms it. Default `after`.

raw.description: The collection's raw data, written as `data/<name>.raw.json`, `data/<name>.csv`, and `data/<name>.sha256`. `false` writes none.

private.description: Fields left out of the published JSON and CSV. Default [].

fields.description: Fields each row carries, in this order, before the record's URL.

bytes.description: Largest chunk, in bytes of the written JSON. Default 100000.

index.description: A compact JSON index of the collection's records for the theme, written under data/.

derivedRule.description: One value derived from a record's date field: a day count (`kind`) or a banded state (`bands`).

field.description: Record field that holds the date; a record without one has no value.

kind.description: `days-left` counts whole days from the as-of day to the field's latest day; `days-since` counts from its earliest day.

field.description: Record field that holds the date; a record without one has no value.

bands.description: Bands in increasing `below` order; the last one has no `below` and takes every count the earlier ones did not.

below.description: Exclusive upper bound of the band, in whole days. Leave it out on the last band.

value.description: The value the derived field has in this band.

collection.description: Collection whose records the feed lists.

where.description: Which records it lists, written like a list page's where. Default: every record.

date.description: Record field that holds the entry date; a record without a valid date is left out.

title.description: Feed title. Default: the site title.

idField.description: Record field whose value extends the entry id, so a new event of the same record is a new entry.

fields.description: Record fields written under the JSON Feed extension key. Default [].

days.description: Last day of the window, counted from the as-of date; both ends are included, so 0 is the as-of date alone.

window.description: Keeps only entries dated from the as-of date to that date plus days, both included. Default: no window.

feed.description: One feed of a collection's records, written under feeds/.

collection.description: Collection whose records the calendar lists.

where.description: Which records it lists, written like a list page's where. Default: every record.

events.description: Events built from each record. At least one.

reminders.description: Reminders before each event as whole days, such as 30d. Default: none.

groupBy.description: Record field whose values each get a calendar of their own under calendars/<name>/.

limit.description: Largest number of events in one file. Default: no limit.

calendar.description: One calendar of a collection's dated records, written as calendars/<name>.ics.

name.description: Event name, kept in the event id, such as eol. Unique per calendar.

field.description: Record field that holds the event's date; it must be one of the collection's dates.

end.description: Record field that holds the last day of a multi-day event; it must be one of the collection's dates.

title.description: Title template; {field} names a record field. Default {title}.

template.description: Markdown template under _templates/, relative to the source folder.

permalink.description: URL pattern of a view page, such as /items/{id}/print/.

layout.description: Layout of a view page. Default: the view template's layout, else record.

dataLimits.description: Limits on one collection's source: bytes, records, and the characters in one field.

bytes.description: Largest source file, in bytes. Default 2097152 (2 MiB).

field.description: Largest value of one field, in characters. Default 100000.

pagination.description: How mizzen data fetch walks a paginated API: the query parameter, the end condition, and the bounds of one fetch.

mode.description: page sends a page number, offset counts records, cursor passes a token, next follows a URL.

param.description: Query parameter for the page number, offset, or cursor. Default page, offset, or cursor.

start.description: page mode: the first page number. offset mode: the first offset. Default 1 for a page, 0 for an offset.

pageSize.description: Records the service returns per page; stop: short compares against it.

stop.description: When a page or offset walk stops: empty on a page with no records, short below pageSize. Required for page and offset.

cursor.description: cursor mode: dot path in the response that holds the next cursor. Absent ends the walk.

next.description: next mode: dot path in the response that holds the next page URL. Absent ends the walk.

origins.description: Origins a next-page URL may name. Default: the source URL's own origin.

env.description: Environment variable that holds the credential. Never written to the config, the lock, or an output.

header.description: Header the credential is sent in. Default Authorization.

prefix.description: Text written before the credential, such as Bearer followed by a space. Default empty.

auth.description: Where a fetched API's credential comes from, and how it is sent.

maxPages.description: Most pages one fetch may read. Default 50.

maxBytes.description: Most bytes one fetch may read across every page. Default: the collection's limits.bytes.

retries.description: Most times one request is retried after a transient failure. Default 2.

collections.description: The collections this version publishes by name.

deprecated.description: true marks the version deprecated in its index; it needs sunset and successor.

sunset.description: The date after which the version may be removed, YYYY-MM-DD.

successor.description: The version consumers should move to.

apiVersion.description: One further version of the data API.
